Name: True Random Geodes
Author: atelier99
Description:
[size=3][center][b]Ever wanted to make your geode drops truly random and not based on how many you've cracked? Tired of knowing what you're getting with your geode predictor mods? Me too![/b][/center] [/size]
[center]With True Random Geodes, this mod alters your amount of geodes cracked to give you different results.

The formula for your geode drops in vanilla is (number of geodes cracked) + (your game's unique ID) / 2. 

This mod uses Harmony to alter the[b] [/b][font=Courier New]getTreasureFromGeode[/font] function in [font=Courier New]Utility.cs[/font] by changing your number of geodes cracked to a random integer to simulate "random" drops. Don't worry, your [i]actual[/i] number of geodes cracked is preserved![/center]

Downloads.Description: The main release. Built for SDV 1.5.6
